name: Steak Wrap with Tomato-Artichoke Relish, Roasted Asparagus & Radish

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
1 bunch radish
1 tomato
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears in half crosswise. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and halve radishes lengthwise. Add to the baking sheet with the asparagus, then drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until asparagus and radish are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, small dice tomato. Place in a small bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the tomato.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Roughly chop capers. Add both to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the tomato-artichoke relish and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 tbsp capers
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
Place tortillas on a flat surface, divide steak between them, then top with relish. Roll tightly to close and cut in half.
To serve, divide wraps and roasted veggies between plates. Enjoy!
